marker_reviews.reason: The dynamic marker is the existence-guarded ALTER TABLE DROP CONSTRAINT. No sidecar check kind expresses the combined outcome (no redundant unique pair index while the identical primary key remains unique): catalog_absence cannot verify the PK keeper, and exact_row_count cannot see pg_constraint definitions. The in-block assertions raise if the pair PK is missing or any non-primary unique index with exactly the same two key columns remains, including renamed constraints and standalone indexes. An absent relation is explicitly skipped. ON CONFLICT inference and duplicate-pair INSERT refusal require post-apply preview proof on issue #6411.
